source_title: TaxDome Releases Public API and MCP Server for AI Agents and Developers - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TaxDome , the practice management platform used by more than 15,000 accounting firms, today released a public API and an MCP server, opening the platform to every firm. Firms can connect Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to their TaxDome data, or build their own tools on top of it, reading and updating data within the limits set by the firm.
"Someone with no development background and a Sunday afternoon can now build what would have taken engineers three months in 2023," said Ilya Radzinsky, co-founder of TaxDome. "Building used to mean writing code. Now it means knowing what you want, and accountants know exactly how their firm should run. They can build it on the data that already runs their practice."
MCP server: connect Claude, ChatGPT or any assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol. Ask which jobs are overdue, get briefed on a client before a call, or set up a new client from an email, in one conversation across TaxDome and the firm's other connected tools.
Public API: read and write access that keeps TaxDome in sync with the firm's other tools. A deal closing in a CRM can create the client account, and a finished meeting can move the job to its next stage.
Firm-controlled access: firm owners decide who on the team can use the API and MCP, and choose for each area of TaxDome whether a connection can read only or also make changes. A connection can never do more than the person who set it up, so it only reaches the clients that person can already see.
More than 200 firms participated in the beta. "The TaxDome MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT has transformed how I run my practice," said Sarah Eck of Eck Tax. "It brings our data together so I can get answers on workload, deadlines, and client activity in seconds."
"We're building Trailhead to be AI-native from the ground up, and the TaxDome API and MCP connector are central to that," said Clay Welch, EA, of Trailhead Tax. "Our tools can see what's waiting, what's missing and what's next, so nothing depends on someone remembering."
The public API and MCP server are rolling out to all TaxDome firms over the coming weeks. Firms can see both live at TaxDome's Fall Update webinar on November 4. Register for the Fall Update webinar .
TaxDome is the leading practice management platform built for tax, bookkeeping and full-service accounting firms. Trusted by 15,000+ practices in 25+ countries, its client app rates at 4.9 stars with 40,000+ reviews and was named a 2026 Webby Award Honoree. TaxDome empowers firms of every size with an award-winning platform that helps them scale and run their firm while also providing their clients with an experience that rivals the world's top consumer brands.
